elements.text: 3. INSTALLATION

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Machine installation should only be carried out by a qualified technician.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Contact your dealer or a qualified electrician for any electrical work that may need to be done.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The sewing machine weighs 28 kg. The installation should be carried out by two or more people.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Do not connect the power cord until installation is complete. The machine may operate if the treadle is depressed by mistake, which could result in injury.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Use both hands to hold the machine head when tilting it back or returning it to its original position. If only using one hand, the weight of the machine head may be too heavy to hold, and may cause human physical injuries.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-1. Installing the table and the table stand

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After unpacking, do not carry the sewing machine holding the lower section of cloth plate cover ❶ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Do not hold the bottom section of the electrical box cover ❷ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Install, air-blower case ❹ , rubber washer ❻ , and rubber cushion ❺ to frame support plate ❸ , referring to the table drawing and parts list.

elements.label: caption
elements.text: 2) Assemble the waste disposal set and the thread stand.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-2. Installing the pedal sensor

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Instal l the pedal sensor to the table wi th mounting screws ❶ supplied with the unit. It is necessary to install the pedal sensor at such a position that the connecting rod is perpendicular to the table.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After the completion of installation of the pedal sensor on the table, place the sewing machine head on the table.

elements.label: caption
elements.text: 3) Assemble the motor starting pedal ❷ to the left side, and the presser foot pedal ❸ to the right side.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-3. Attaching the connecting rod

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and a lapse of 5 minutes or more.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Fix connecting rod ❶ to installing hole ❹ of pedal lever ❷ with nut ❸ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-4. Connecting the connector

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: To protect against personal injury resulting from abrupt start of the sewing machine, be sure to turn the power OFF, unplug the machine and wait for five minutes or more before installing the pedal sensor.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: To prevent damage of device caused by maloperation and wrong specifications, be sure to connect all the corresponding connectors to the specified places. (If any of the connectors is inserted into a wrong connector, not only the device corresponding to the connector can break but also it can start abruptly, inviting the risk of personal injury.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: To prevent personal injury caused by maloperation, be sure to lock the connector with lock.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Do not connect the power plug until the connection of cords is completed.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Fix the cords while taking care not to forcibly bend them or excessively clamp them with staples.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: As for the details of handling respective devices, read carefully the Instruction Manuals supplied with the devices before handling the devices.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Do not insert the power plug into the wall outlet.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check to be sure that the power switch is turned OFF.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Be sure to fully insert the connectors into the corresponding ports until they are locked.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Draw out pedal sensor cable ❶ coming from the electrical box to the undersurface of the table.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Connect pedal sensor cable ❶ and the connector under the table.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-5. Installing the reactor box [Only for the EU type models]

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: For the EU-type models, install the reactor box that is supplied with the sewing machine.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Detach reactor cover ❷ from reactor box ❶ to separate from reactor base asm. ❸ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The reactor cover can be detached with ease by inserting a tool that has a thin flat tip such as a flat-blade screwdriver between the cover and base.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Slide reactor ❺ in the direction of the arrow to insert into reactor base asm. ❸ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: When inserting the reactor, detach bundled wire clamp ❻ beforehand.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Insert reactor ❺ into the reactor base asm. while facing brown and blue lead wires side upward.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Connect the connector ❼ of the power cord that is fixed to reactor base asm. ❸ to the connector of reactor ❺ .

elements.label: text
elements.text: Be sure to insert the former fully into the latter until the connector is locked.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Take out wood screws (ST4.2 x 25) from screw bag ❹ . Secure reactor base asm. ❸ and reactor ❺ to the undersurface of sewing machine table with the wood screws (at four locations).

elements.label: text
elements.text: Refer to the instruction figure shown in the following step of procedure 10) for the mounting positions of the reactor cover and reactor base asm.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Secure power cord asm. ❽ coming from the electrical box to reactor base asm. ❸ with bundled wire clamp ❾ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Connect the connector of power cord asm. ❽ to connector of reactor ❺ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Secure earth terminal  of power cord asm. ❽ to earth base  with a screw.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Secure the earth terminal to the screw with earth mark .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Fit reactor cover ❷ over reactor base asm. ❸ .

elements.label: text
elements.text: Take care not to allow the cord to be caught under reactor cover ❷. Pass the power cord through cord bushing . Then, insert the power cord into the slit portion

elements.label: text
elements.text: of reactor cover ❷ and hold it with reactor base asm. ❸.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Take out reactor cover fixing screws from screw bag ❹ . Secure reactor cover ❷ to reactor base asm. ❸ with the fixing screws (at four locations).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Attach AC input cable  and output cable  on the undersurface of table using supplied staple  .

elements.label: text
elements.text: At this time, take care not to cross the input- and output-cables  .

elements.label: text
elements.text: AC input cable and output cable  should be used with lightly bundled with an accessory cable clip band.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-5. How to install the power plug

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: 1. Be sure to attach the ground wire (green/yellow) to the specified location (on the ground side).

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Take care not to allow terminals to come in contact with each other.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 3-6. Power switch

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Connect the power cord to power plug ❶ . Connect the blue and brown wires (1ø) to the power supply side and the green/yellow wire to the earth side as illustrated in the figure.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Be sure to prepare the power plug ❶ which conforms to the safety standard.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Be sure to connect the ground lead (green/yellow) to the grounding side.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Check that the power switch is in the OFF state. Then, insert the power plug ❶ coming from the power switch into the plug receptacle.

elements.label: text
elements.text: In prior to the connection of the power plug ❶, re-check the supply voltage specification indicated on the control box.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The power plug ❶ is different in shape according to the destination of the sewing machine.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turning the power ON with the power switch ❶ The power to the sewing machine is placed in the ON state when the "|" mark side of power switch ❶ (1ø 220 - 240V type) is pressed; or in the OFF state when the "0" mark side is pressed. The power to the sewing machine is placed in the ON state when the knob of power switch ❷ (EU type, 1ø 220 - 240V type) is turned by 90 degrees counterclockwise; or in the OFF state when it is turned clockwise to return to its home position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Do not strongly tap the power switch by hand.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If the power indicator LED on the panel does not light up after having turned ON the power switch ❶❷ , immediately turn OFF the power switch and check the supply voltage.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: When you want to re-turn ON power switch ❶❷ after carrying out the aforementioned steps, it is necessary to wait for five minutes or more after you have turned OFF power switch ❶❷ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Do not place your hand or anything under the needle since the needle bar may automatically move according to the memory switch setting when you turn ON the power to the sewing machine.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4. LUBRICATION AND DRAINAGE

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-1. Lubrication oil

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove oil sight window ❶ from the oil inlet. Add lubricating oil specifically made for machines which run at a super-high speed (JUKI MACHINE OIL #18) supplied with the unit or equivalent through the oil inlet. When the oil surface reaches the space between two marker lines on the oil gauge, tighten oil sight window ❶.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: (Only for the MO-6800S) Before using a new sewing machine for the first time after the purchase or the sewing machine which has not been used for an extended period of time, the shaded sections of needle bar ❷ and upper looper guide ❸ have to be lubricated.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Take care not to pour too much amount of lubricating oil at the time of lubrication. If the machine is lubricated with an excessive amount of oil, oil leakage can be caused.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-2. Drainage and refill the oil

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❶ and drain all the oil inside the oil tank. Then, tighten the screw ❶ again.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: In order to extend the term of usage, please replace the oil after the first four weeks, and then replace it every four months.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: To extend the usage term, this machine has equipped an oil filter ❷ . Clean up this oil filter ❷ once every month and change it with a new one where necessary.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Needle cooling lubrication oil : SILICON OIL

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 4-3. Exclusive grease replenishment (only for the MO-6800D)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Periodical replenishment of the exclusive grease (once every one or two years) will be effective to ensure smooth operation of the machine.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: How to replenish the needle bar compartment with grease

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove grease replenishing rubber plug ❶ from the needle bar compartment.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: How to replenish the looper compartment with grease

elements.label: caption
elements.text: 1) Remove grease replenishing rubber plug ❶ from the looper compartment.

elements.label: caption
elements.text: 2) Replenish grease by means of a tip of screwdriver ❸ , ❷ or the like. Use JUKI GREASE A for the replenishment of grease JUKI GREASE A: 40006323 (part number)

elements.label: caption
elements.text: 2) Replenish grease by means of a tip of screwdriver ❸ , ❷ or the like. Use JUKI GREASE A for the replenishment of grease JUKI GREASE A: 40006323 (part number)

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5. PREPARATION BEFORE SEWING

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-1. Threading

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: Follow the procedures for threading. Wrong threading can cause stitching troubles such as thread breakage, stitch skipping and puckering.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-2. Adjusting the thread tension

elements.label: text
elements.text: The thread tension should be adjusted properly according to the kinds and the thickness of the materials, stitch length, and seam width, etc. In addition, adjust the nuts case by case individually. Turn the nuts clockwisely will increase the thread tension. Otherwise, the thread tension will be decreased.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (1) Thread tension adjusting nuts

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tension adjusting nut No. ① controls thread ❶ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tension adjusting nut No. ② controls thread ❷ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tension adjusting nut No. ③ controls thread ❸ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tension adjusting nut No. ④ controls thread ❹ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tension adjusting nut No. ⑤ controls thread ❺ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (2) Adjusting the needle thread length

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Adjust the needle thread length by turning the thread guide in the directions of arrows.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The ⊕ direction indicates to increase the needle thread length.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The ⊖ direction indicates to decrease the needle thread length.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (3) Adjusting the looper thread cam thread guide

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-3. Replace the needle

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: In the case the looper thread is not appropriately adjusted, thread loops cannot be formed with consistency. (Thread can be excessively loosened or thread loops cannot be formed.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ⊕ means to have more thread amount while sewing.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ⊖ means to have less thread amount while sewing.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Please use the needle DC × 27 or the equivalents.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❶ and take off the needle.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Fully insert the new needle into the needle clamp hole with the needle recess facing backwards as viewed from the operator's side.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the screw ❶ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-4. Adjusting the stitch length

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Change the stitch length appropriately according to the material to be used, differential feed ratio or other relevant factors.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Keep pressing the button ❶ and turn the pulley till the button is locked. Then, release the button after reaching the desired stitch length.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-5. Adjusting the differential feed ratio

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen differential feed adjusting nut ❷ . Move differential feed adjusting rod ❶ upward to perform stretching sewing, or downward to perform shirring.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: When you want to move the lever ❶ only slightly, use differential feed minute-adjust screw ❸ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After the adjustment, securely tighten differential feed adjusting nut ❷ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-6. Replace the knives

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (1) Replace the upper knife

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❶ and move the lower knife holder ❷ to the left. Then, tighten the screw ❶ a little.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove the screw ❸ and put the new upper knife. Then, tighten the screw ❸ a little.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the pulley to move the upper knife to the lower dead point. Adjust the height of the upper knife so that the upper knife can cross the lower knife about 0.5 to 1.0 mm. After that, tighten the screw ❸ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❶ and return the lower knife holder ❷ to its original position. Test if the upper and the lower knife can cut the thread exactly, and then tighten the screw ❶ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (2) Replace the lower knife

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❶ and move the lower knife holder ❷ to the left. Then, tighten the screw ❶ a little.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❹ . Take off the lower knife and replace a new one.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Adjust the edge of the lower knife to be aligned with the surface of the throat plate. Then, tighten the screw ❹ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❶ to return the lower knife holder ❷ to its original position and test if the upper and the lower knife can cut the thread exactly. Then, tighten the screw ❶ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-7. Adjusting the overedge width

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-8. Adjusting the needle height

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the pulley to move the upper knife ❹ to the lower dead point.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❶ and move the lower knife holder ❷ to the left, and then tighten the screw ❶ a little.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❸ , and move the upper knife holder left or right till reaching the desired width. Then, tighten the screw ❸ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen screw ❶ . Move the lower knife holder ❷ until the lower knife comes in contact with the upper knife.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Test if the knives can cut the thread, and then tighten the screw ❶ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Turn the pulley to bring the needle to its upper end. At this time, adjust the distance from the needle tip to the top surface of the throat plate appropriately.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen four screws ❶ . Open top cover ❷ and detach it.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❸ , and move the needle bar ❹ to the desired height. Then, tighten the screw ❸ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Close top cover ❷ . Tighten four screws ❶ .

elements.label: text
elements.text: After the adjustment of the needle bar height, check the relation between the needle and the looper.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Refer to "8-1. Dimensions use to adjusting the looper and the needle guard" p.41 for the adjustment values of the needle height.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-9. Adjusting the presser foot

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (1) Adjusting the presser foot position

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen adjusting screw ❶ and screw ❼ of the presser foot.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Move the presser foot ❻ so that the groove of the presser foot can align with the groove of the throat plate. Also the bottom of the presser foot can stand on the throat plate flatly and then tighten the screw ❼.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❺ and move ❹ left and right so that ❸ can match ❷ and ❷ can move upward and downward smoothly. Then, tighten the screw ❺ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: To adjust to a proper pressure: turn the screw ❶ clockwise will increase the pressure, whereas turn it counter clockwise will decrease the pressure.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (2) Adjusting the lift amount of the presser foot

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the pulley to lower the feed dog until the bottom of the presser horizontally comes in contact with the throat plate.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Provide a 1 mm clearance between presser foot lifting arm ❶ and fixing bracket ❷ . This clearance can be adjusted by slightly loosening screw ❸ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen nut ❹ . Press presser foot lifting lever ❻ to lift the presser foot from the throat plate surface. The lift of the presser foot differs with the model. Adjust the lift of the presser foot according to the model referring to the table shown below.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Then, adjust screw ❺ so that it comes in contact with presser foot lifting lever ❻ . Tighten nut ❹ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: After all the adjustments above, please tighten the screw ❸ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-10. Adjusting the feed dog

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (1) Adjusting the feed dog height

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the pulley to rise the feed dog the highest point.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❶ . and move the main feed dog ❷ up and down in order to keep the teeth side over the throat plate about 0.9 to 1.1 mm (30P: 0.7 to 0.9 mm, 60H: 1.0 to 1.2 mm). Then, tighten the screw ❶.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen screw ❸ . Move differential feed dog ❹ up and down to adjust so that it is flush with main feed dog ❷ . Then, tighten screw ❸ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (2) Adjusting the inclination of the feed dog

elements.label: text
elements.text: To adjust the inclination of the feed dog, loosen screw ❶ and turn rear support shaft ❷ . When the feed dog is flush with the top surface of the throat plate and the feed dog is levelled (30P: The feed dog is positioned with its front part low), tighten screw ❶ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (3) Adjusting the auxiliary feed dog height

elements.label: text
elements.text: The teeth section of auxiliary feed dog ❶ has to be positioned lower than main feed dog ❸ by 0.3 to 0.5 mm (30P: 0.1 to 0.3 mm, 60H: 0.25 to 0.35 mm). The height can be adjusted by loosening the screw ❷ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-11. The relationship between the needle and the looper

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (1) The relationship between the needle and the upper looper

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (2) The relationship between the needle and the lower looper

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: When the lower looper moves to the leftest point, the distance between the looper tip and the center line of the needle should be about 3.7 to 3.9 mm (40H, 44H, 50H and 60H : 4.1 to 4.3 mm). For 2-needle model, the distance is from the lower looper tip to the center line of the left needle.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Adjust the distance f rom the looper tip to the scarf of the needle to 0.01 to 0.1 mm when the lower looper moves to the right toward the center line of the needle (for the 2-needle models, the lef t needle is used as the reference).

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the upper looper moves to the leftmost point, the distance from the looper tip to the center line of the needle is 4.8 to 5.2 mm. For 2-needle model, the distance from the looper tip to the center line of the left needle is 5.4 to 5.7 mm (60H: 5.0 to 5.5 mm).

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (3) The relationship between the upper looper and the lower looper

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the upper and the lower loopers cross, keep them as close as possible.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Somehow, the loopers shall not either touch nor collide to each other. The clearance of 0.05 to 0.2 mm should be provided between the upper and lower loopers when they are crossing.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (4) The relationship between the needle and the double chainstitch looper

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the double chainstitch looper moves to reach its leftmost position, the distance from the double chainstitch looper to the center line of the needle should be 1.4 to 1.9 mm (50H, 60H: 1.6 to 2.3 mm).

elements.label: text
elements.text: Adjust so that the clearance of 0 ± 0.05 mm is provided between crest A of the lower end of scarf of double chainstitch needle ❹ and double chainstitch looper ❺ .

elements.label: text
elements.text: At this time, the tip of double chainstitch looper ❺ should be located inside the side face of double chainstitch needle ❹ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: (5) The relationship between the needle and the needle guard

elements.label: text
elements.text: Adjust so that movable needle guard ❷ comes in light contact with the needle when overlock needle ❶ (left needle for the 2-needle model) is brought to its lower end position.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Adjust so that the distance from needle ❶ to front needle guard ❸ to 0.1 to 0.2 mm.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 5-12. Adjusting the amount of travel of the double chainstitch looper

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: text
elements.text: To protect against possible personal injury due to abrupt start of the machine, be sure to start the following work after turning the power off and ascertaining that the motor is at rest.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The double chainstitch looper makes elliptic movement. Adjust the amount of front/rear travel A of the double chainstitch looper following the steps of procedure described below where necessary.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Open rear cover ❶ of the sewing machine.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Loosen the screw ❸ slightly.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn the screw ❷ to adjust. To increase the amount of travel, turn to ⊕ direction.

elements.label: text
elements.text: To decrease the amount of travel, turn to ⊖ direction.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Tighten the screw ❸ after the adjustment.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: At the end of the adjustment, close rear cover ❶.

elements.text: 6-3. Function setting

elements.label: text
elements.text: Functions can be selected and set as described below.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Press ❶ .

elements.label: text
elements.text: The display on the display section A is changed over to display the Function setting No. (P- * *).

elements.label: text
elements.text: (The display item that has been previously changed is displayed unless you have turned the power OFF after you changed the setting last time. )

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If the display on the screen fails to change, carry out the operation procedure 1) again.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Be sure to re-turn ON the power switch after 10 seconds or more have passed after you turned OFF the power switch. If you re-turn ON the power switch immediately after you have turned it OFF, the sewing machine may fail to operate normally. In such a case, be sure to re-turn ON the power switch.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Functions can be selected and set as described below.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: When you want to change the function setting num-

elements.label: text
elements.text: ber, change it by pressing ❸ and ❹ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: When you press ❷ after you have changed the function setting number, the set value of the relevant function setting number is displayed.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Change the set value by pressing ❸ and

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Confirm the set value by pressing ❷ .

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If you have changed the set value during sewing, there is a parameter that enable the set value when you depress the back part of the pedal.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If you keep ❺ held pressed without confirming the set value in step 5), only the set value that is currently selected can be saved to memory. While the set value is being saved, the word "SAVE" is displayed on the screen.

elements.label: text
elements.text: After the set value has been saved, the screen returns to the normal sewing screen.

elements.text: Refer to "6-6. Initialization of the function setting data" p.37 for how to initialize the function setting data.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 6-5. Details of setting of the main functions

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: ① Stop position setting (Function setting No. P02)

elements.label: text
elements.text: This function setting number is used for setting the stop position of the needle.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 0: The needle stops at its upper position

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 1: The needle stops at its lower position

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 2: The needle stop position is not specified

elements.label: text
elements.text: The needle stop position can also be changed with the relevant button on the operation panel.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The upper stop position and the lower stop position can be selected alternately by pressing ❺ .

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the display B dot lights up, the needle stops at its upper position. When the display B dot goes out, the needle stops at its lower position.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: In the case the function setting number "P02" is set to "2: The needle stop position is not specified" under the function setting mode, the needle stop position is not specified regardless of ON / OFF of the display B dot.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: In the case "6: Intermittent suction (controlled by the number of stitches)" is selected for the function setting number "P17 Pedal control suction 1 type" or "P22 Pedal control suction 2 type", "2: The needle stop position is not specified" is not allowed to be selected.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: ② Selection of soft-start function (Function setting No. P03)

elements.label: text
elements.text: P03 0: Soft start OFF

elements.label: text
elements.text: 1: Soft start ON

elements.label: text
elements.text: It is also possible to change the speed limit value for the soft start function and the number of stitches to be sewn with the soft start function. (Function setting No. P04 - No. P05)

elements.label: text
elements.text: P04 Data settable range: 200 - 1500 [sti / min] <100 sti / min>

elements.label: text
elements.text: P05 Data settable range: 1 - 15 (stitches)

elements.label: text
elements.text: The soft-start function selection can also be changed with the relevant button on the operation panel.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The soft start OFF and ON can be selected alternately by keeping ❺ held pressed.

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the display C dot lights up, the soft start ON is selected. When the display C dot goes out, the soft start OFF is selected.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: ③ Selection of the presser foot lifting function (Function setting No. P16)

elements.label: text
elements.text: This is the function to select whether the presser foot is lifted or not when the back part of the pedal is depressed.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: This selection is enabled in the case the presser foot lifting device is connected to the sewing machine. (Refer to the Engineer's Manual for the detailed connection method.)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 0: The presser foot lifting operation is not carried out.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 1: The presser foot lifting operation is carried out.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: ④ Selection of the suction function (Function setting No. P17 and No. P22)

elements.label: text
elements.text: This function setting is enabled when the suction device is connected to the suction 1 or 2. (Refer to the Engineer's Manual for the detailed connection method of the suction 1 and suction 2.) For each of the devices connected, the suction function can be separately selected.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: P17, P22 0: Suction OFF

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 1: Front suction

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 2: Rear suction

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 3: Front and rear suction

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 4: Long suction

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 5: Intermittent suction (controlled by time)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 6: Intermittent suction (controlled by the number of stitches)

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: In the case "2: The needle stop position is not specified" is selected for the function setting number "P02 Stop position selection", "6: Intermittent suction (controlled by the number of stitches)" cannot be set.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: ⑤ Selection of the manual thread trimming function (Function setting No. P12 and No. P28)

elements.label: text
elements.text: This selection is enabled in the case the manual switch is connected to the sewing machine.

elements.label: text
elements.text: (Refer to the Engineer's Manual for the detailed connection method of the manual switch.)

elements.label: text
elements.text: The number of times of manual thread trimming can be selected.

elements.label: text
elements.text: P12 Setting range: 1 - 5 times

elements.label: text
elements.text: In addition, the suction function at the time of manual thread trimming can be selected.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: P28 0: Suction OFF

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 1: The device connected to Suction 1 is operated

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 2: The device connected to Suction 2 is operated

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: 3: Both devices connected to Suction 1 and Suction 2 are operated

elements.label: text
elements.text: (Refer to the Engineer's Manual for the detailed connection method of the suction.)

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: ⑥ Production number counting function (Function setting No. P35 and P36)

elements.label: text
elements.text: This is the function to count the number of pieces produced.

elements.label: text
elements.text: P35 Number of pieces: 0 - 9999 pieces

elements.label: text
elements.text: In addition, the number of times of thread trimming to be carried out before adding one to the count number can be set.

elements.label: text
elements.text: P36 Setting range: 1 - 50 times

elements.label: text
elements.text: It is possible to carry out the sewing while the number of pieces is displayed.

elements.label: text
elements.text: If you want to reset the number of pieces to "0", keep ❺ held pressed. The number of pieces pro-

elements.label: text
elements.text: duced can be increased or decreased by pressing ❸ or ❹ .

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 6-6. Initialization of the function setting data

elements.label: text
elements.text: The function setting data you have changed arbitrarily can be stored in memory. If you change the data afterward, it can be returned to the aforementioned data that you have stored in memory.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: The initialization screen is displayed by keeping ❸ held pressed for five seconds in the normal sewing state or by turning ON the power to the sewing machine while pressing ❸ and ❹ simultaneously.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: In the case you have kept ❸ held pressed for a long time to display the initialization screen, all of the set values can be initialized to those you have stored in memory as described in "6-3. Function setting" p.30 by pressing ❷ on the initial-

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: ization screen. In the case you have turned the power ON by pressing ❸ and ❹ simultaneously, the set values will be reset to the factory-set initial values at the time of shipment. In this case, the set values you have stored in memory as described in "6-3. Function setting" p.30 will also be initialized to the factory-set values.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Initialization can be cancelled by pressing ❶.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: During the initialization, the full-screen is displayed. After the completion of the initialization, the screen returns to the normal sewing-state screen.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: 7. MAINTENANCE

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: WARNING :

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Turn off the power switch before carrying out cleaning. The machine may operate if the treadle is pressed incautiously, which could result in injury.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Be sure to wear protective goggles and gloves when handling the lubricating oil and grease so that they do not get into your eyes or onto your skin, otherwise inflammation can be resulted.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Furthermore, do not drink or eat the oil nor the grease for they can cause vomiting and diarrhea. Keep the oil away of the reach of children.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Use both hands to hold the machine head when tilting or returning it to its original position. If only using one hand to move the machine, the weight of the machine head may cause slipping and you may get hurt.
